s-1.ptxt: Install Front Drive Shaft Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Apply Toyota Genuine ATF WS to the splines of the inboard joint assembly LH.
Face the snap ring opening downward.
Align the splines of the drive shaft and transaxle, and insert the drive shaft assembly LH using a brass bar and hammer.

item.ptxt: Do not damage the oil seal.
Do not damage the drive shaft boot.

atten4.ptxt: Determine that the drive shaft is fully driven in by a change in the reaction force of the brass bar or a change in the sound.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Drive Shaft Assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Apply Toyota Genuine ATF WS to the splines of the inboard joint assembly RH.
Align the splines of the drive shaft and transaxle, insert the drive shaft assembly, and tighten it with the 2 bolts.

atten3.ptxt: Do not damage the oil seal.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Axle Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Push the front axle assembly LH toward the outside of the vehicle, align the splines of the front drive shaft assembly LH with the front axle assembly LH, and insert it.

item.ptxt: Do not push the front axle assembly LH out farther than necessary.
Do not damage the oil seal.
Do not damage the boot of the front drive shaft assembly LH.
Do not damage the speed sensor rotor.
Check that there is no foreign matter on the speed sensor rotor or insertion part.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Axle Assembly RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Suspension Arm Sub-assembly Lower NO.1 LH

s2.ptxt: Push down the front suspension lower arm No.1 LH, install the front lower ball joint LH, and tighten it with the 1 bolts and 2 nuts.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Suspension Arm Sub-assembly Lower NO.1 RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Stabilizer Link Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Install the front stabilizer link assembly to the shock absorber assembly with the nut.

atten4.ptxt: Using hexagon wrench 6, hold the stud bolt so that it does not spin.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Stabilizer Link Assembly RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Install Tie Rod End LH

s2.ptxt: Connect the tie rod end LH to the steering knuckle and install it with the castle nut.

atten3.ptxt: After tightening the castle nut, align the cotter pin hole by further tightening the nut within 60°.

s2.ptxt: Install a new cotter pin.

s-1.ptxt: Install Tie Rod End RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Install Speed Sensor Front LH

s2.ptxt: Install the speed sensor to the steering knuckle with bolt C.

item.ptxt: Check that there is no foreign matter on the speed sensor tip and installation part.
When installing the speed sensor, do not insert it while rotated relative to the tightening position.
Do not tighten the bolt with the sensor tilted.

s2.ptxt: Install the clip to the steering knuckle.
Using bolt A, install sensor clamp No.1 together with the brake flexible hose to the shock absorber.

item.ptxt: Install the speed sensor front LH wire harness without twisting it.
Assemble so that the clamp of the speed sensor front LH is on the near side.

s2.ptxt: Install sensor clamp No.2 to the body with bolt B.

atten3.ptxt: Install the speed sensor front LH wire harness without twisting it.

s2.ptxt: Connect the connector.
Install the speed sensor clip to the body.

s-1.ptxt: Install Speed Sensor Front RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Axle Shaft Nut LH

s2.ptxt: Using white gasoline, clean the threads of the drive shaft and axle shaft nut.

item.ptxt: Be sure to clean new drive shafts as well.
Completely clean off and remove any oil, foreign matter, etc.

s2.ptxt: Using a socket wrench (30mm), install a new front axle hub nut LH.
Using a chisel and hammer, stake the front axle hub nut LH.

entry.ptxt: Oil Temperature Detection Mode Switching Procedure
Perform the N - D operation within 1.5 seconds
Perform the above operation continuously for 6 seconds or more

s3.ptxt: The meter indicator light [D] illuminates for 2 seconds and then goes off.
Depending on the fluid temperature, the meter indicator light comes on, goes off or blinks.

item.ptxt: Add fluid while the meter indicator light is illuminated.
If the meter indicator light is off, adjust the fluid temperature [*4] to between 40° and C-45°C.
If the meter indicator light is blinking, check the vehicle condition and wait for the fluid temperature to drop before performing the work.

s3.ptxt: Move the shift lever to the P range.
Disconnect terminals 13 (TC) ←→ 4 (CG) of DLC3.
